#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

bool isWordChar(char c) {
    return (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= '0' && c <= '9') || c == '_';
}

int longestWords(const string& line) {
    int best = 0;
    stringstream ss(line);
    string word;
    while (getline(ss, word, '_')) {
        best = max(best, (int)word.length());
    }
    return best;
}

long long countInside(const string& inner) {
    long long count = 0;
    stringstream ss(inner);
    string part;
    while (getline(ss, part, '_')) {
        if (!part.empty()) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

void solve(int testNumber, istream& in, ostream& out) {
    int n;
    in >> n;
    string s;
    in >> s;
    int longest = 0;
    long long inside = 0;
    string outside;
    bool endedWithMatch = false;
    int i = 0;
    int len = s.length();
    while (i < len) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (c == '(') {
            int j = i + 1;
            while (j < len && isWordChar(s[j])) {
                j++;
            }
            if (j < len && s[j] == ')') {
                longest = max(longest, longestWords(outside));
                outside.clear();
                inside += countInside(s.substr(i + 1, j - i - 1));
                i = j + 1;
                endedWithMatch = true;
                continue;
            }
        }
        outside.push_back(c);
        i++;
        endedWithMatch = false;
    }
    if (!endedWithMatch || outside.length() > 0) {
        longest = max(longest, longestWords(outside));
    }
    out << longest << " " << inside << endl;
}

int main() {
    solve(1, cin, cout);
    return 0;
}
